newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Kidnapped Brazilian baby found in athletic bag.
newsitem.headline: Kidnapped Brazilian baby found in athletic bag.

text.p: A three-day-old baby boy snatched from a Rio de Janeiro maternity ward over the weekend was found on Monday alive and well in an athletic bag near a bus terminal, authorities said.
Rafael Zappa was discovered by a woman and her daughter who heard his cries as they got off a bus near the town of Teresopolis, 50 miles (90 km) northeast of Rio, police said.
Baby Rafael, kidnapped on Sunday by a woman disguised as a nurse, was returned in excellent health to his parents at their home, a hospital spokeswoman said.
The woman who took Rafael told his parents she was taking the boy to give him some glucose, the spokeswoman said.
